pages.text: Your dolls$(br2)A doll has 20 health and is bound to you. You can have up to 8 dolls active at once. They follow you, fight with the equipment in their loadouts when ordered, and can heal their own allies while holding a talisman — but attacks and other orders still have to come from you.
They won't be lost$(br2)If you log out or die, your active dolls are safely put away and restored with you later.
